# SaneCppLibraries FileSystemWatcher

Source: https://github.com/Pagghiu/SaneCppLibraries/tree/main/Libraries/FileSystemWatcher

Vendored from upstream commit `0134d31` to support `poryaaaa~` voicegroup
reload watching on macOS and Windows. The imported files keep their upstream MIT
license headers; `LICENSE.txt` is copied from the upstream repository.
